description: This file is a PHP source file defining the 'Coupon' model class within the OpenCart eCommerce system. It manages CRUD operations, relationships, and data retrieval for coupons, including associated products, categories, and histories.
external_files: (database connection and utility classes, such as db.php, engine.php, model.php)
tables: oc_coupon, oc_coupon_product, oc_coupon_category, oc_coupon_history, oc_customer

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Model class for managing coupon data, including creation, updating, deletion, retrieval, and relationships with products, categories, and histories within the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addCoupon
methods.description: Creates a new coupon record in the database with provided data, including associated products and categories if specified.

methods.name: editCoupon
methods.description: Updates an existing coupon record identified by coupon_id with new data and manages related products and categories.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the active/inactive status of a coupon.

methods.name: deleteCoupon
methods.description: Removes a coupon and its associated product, category, and history data from the database.

methods.name: getCoupon
methods.description: Retrieves a coupon record by coupon_id.

methods.name: getCouponByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a coupon record matching a specific code.

methods.name: getCoupons
methods.description: Returns a list of coupons with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with a coupon.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Deletes all product associations for a given coupon.

methods.name: deleteProductsByProductId
methods.description: Deletes all coupon product associations for a specific product.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product IDs associated with a coupon.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Associates a category with a coupon.

methods.name: deleteCategories
methods.description: Deletes all category associations for a given coupon.

methods.name: deleteCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Deletes all coupon category associations for a specific category.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of category IDs associated with a coupon.

methods.name: getTotalCoupons
methods.description: Returns the total number of coupons.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of coupon usage histories.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records for a coupon.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history records for a coupon.
